title: Made me nervous
text:
Made me nervous. Started baking to the bottom of my oven after a couple months.
Threw it out.

product_metadata.title: Cooks Innovations Non-Stick Oven Protector Mat - Heavy Duty Nonstick Oven Rack Liners to Protect Convection, Electric, Gas, & Microwave Ovens - BPA & PFOA Free Heat Resistant Baking Mat
features: CUT TO FIT: Our air fryer liners square comes in 16.5" x 23" square guards that can be trimmed to fit most ovens and air fryers! Instead of struggling to find the size you need, our microwave oven rack liners will fit almost any oven.

DURABLE: Our 100% non-stick PTFE toaster oven tray lining keeps the bottom of your oven clean when placed on an oven rack below whatever you're baking! Our oven guard protects your oven from spills, drops, and drips from pies, casseroles, pizza, and more before they burn and stick. Eliminate a tedious chore with our oven liner!

EASY TO USE: Simply cut our professional-grade air fryer liners to fit on a rack near the bottom of your oven and place them down! Our oven shelf liner is thinner and more lightweight than others to make it easy to remove for cleaning. Conform our gas oven guard to your oven easily while still catching spills and splatters!

DISHWASHER SAFE: Don't stress out about stubborn oven rack guards. Our liners for air fryer basket can be easily removed and washed in the dishwasher. You can also clean our roaster liners with just one wipe by hand!

NO SCRUBBING: Say goodbye to splatters and burned-on messes with our oven gap cover! Avoid scrubbing and wiping hard-to-reach areas with our removable oven liners. These elegant black guards for your electric pizza oven blend in with your oven so your guests will never know they're there!
